Approval Workflow

Who approves what, and in what order.

Routing Rules

  • Under 500 EUR: manager approval
  • 500 to 5000 EUR: manager plus finance
  • Over 5000 EUR: director sign-off

Escalation

If an approver is out of office for more than three days, the request escalates to their delegate.
